text: Your website could be broken right now, and nobody would tell you.
Here are 4 quick checks. Two minutes, on your phone.
Check one. Type site: then your web address into Google.
say: Check one. Type site, colon, then your web address into Google.

text: Nothing shows up? Then Google doesn't know your site exists.
Check two. Look at the address bar. Does it say Not secure?
That means no security certificate. Lots of hosts include one free.
Check three. Paste your web address into PageSpeed Insights. It's free, from Google.
Look at the mobile score. Red, under 50, means slow.
say: Look at the mobile score. Red, under fifty, means slow.

text: Check four. Fill in your own contact form, and see if the email actually arrives.
Broken forms fail silently. You just stop getting enquiries.
How many did your site pass? Save this, and follow for more.
